_note: Per-product English for everything that comes out of the Korean deck: spec values, the one-liner, and the [features & benefits] block. Brief text lives in briefs.json, the longer write-ups in etc.json.
_rules: A creator reads this and uses it. Write with conviction.
Never write 'the deck doesn't say', 'we couldn't read it', 'until this is confirmed'. If something is unclear, state only the part that is certain.
Instead of 'don't say X', give them the line they can say.
Don't keep citing the deck. State the fact.
Where getting it wrong matters (an expired certificate, a result that needed three products), say it in one short, plain sentence.
No prices, launch dates, manufacturer, phone numbers, certificate numbers or internal notes.
